title: 10am: Lock in on command.
excerpt: Most founders never get a real 10am. Hatch one at 2pm. Or 2am. A quiet layer over your screen and audio. Free for macOS.

Don't leave deep work to fate.

Some days everything clicks and three hours pass like ten minutes. It’s the best work you do. You need that on command.

Deep work, on purpose.

01START

One tap to lock in.

10am lives in your menu bar. Tap the egg; it hatches; the block starts. No timer screen, no breathing exercise, nothing to step away for. You just keep working.

02HOLD

Screen and sound sustain focus.

A quiet rhythm in your screen and audio, low-contrast, tuned to reduce distraction on the cognitive level. More on the mechanism below.

03READ

Stop, and your score prints.

See how you feel: camera and system signals, optional and off by default, help you understand your mental state in real time. No extra devices. Nothing leaves your Mac.

Bring your calls and music.

10am sound mixes with whatever you’re already hearing. When your system speaks, it makes room. Nothing to mute, nothing to turn off, nothing competing for your attention.

Listening to music? 10am coordinates in real time.

LOCKS TO

SPOTIFYAPPLE MUSICYOUTUBE+ CALLS AND MEDIA

What does your 10am look like?

Every block ends with a receipt. One score, 0 to 100, served when you finish.

FOCUS ONSETHow fast you dropped in.

WORK SCOREThe number you’ll start chasing.

ATTENTION RESILIENCEHow long you held the line.

10am runs through VAEL.

VVISUALTHE WIDE CHANNEL

Vision is the brain’s widest channel, about a third of cortex. 10am reaches it with a low-contrast rhythm over your screen, faint enough that you stop noticing it in about a minute. Your visual cortex doesn’t.

AAUDIOTHE SECOND CHANNEL

The same rhythm runs inside your audio: its own quiet sound, or locked to your music. Two senses carrying one signal, each reinforcing the other.

EENTRAINMENTTHE EFFECT

Show your visual system a steady pulse and it falls in step, measurably, on an EEG. Neuroscience has used this effect to read attention for about forty years. 10am runs it the other way.

LLAYERTHE FORM FACTOR

Not a session, not another app. It runs underneath whatever you’re already doing, and you keep working the whole time. That’s the part everything else gets wrong.

THE LAST ACRONYM ON THIS PAGE

Receipts.

The science behind the layer: sample sizes, preprint labels, and hedges left on.

MECHANISM

Audiovisual brainwave entrainment, a standard in neuroscience for ~40 years. Vision is the brain’s widest channel: about a third of cortex.

LAB

40 Hz flicker held vigilance across a full hour. Both control conditions degraded.Attokaren et al. · 2025 · preprint · n=62 · 60 min

FIELD

Flickering display during vigilance tasks; EEG visibility correlated with task success.Ladouce et al. · 2024–2025 · ISAE-SUPAERO + Airbus

TRAINING, NOT TREATMENT · NO MEDICAL CLAIMS

Nothing leaves your Mac.

CAMERA

Optional, off by default. Frames are read on-device, never stored, never uploaded.

TYPING

Never what you type. Only the rhythm.

SCREEN

Nothing about what’s on it is captured, uploaded, or stored.

YOUR DATA

Everything stays local. Local API and MCP access available upon request so your tools can see what 10am sees.

Not a toggle buried in settings. The architecture.

Security notes →

First days on the house.

WEEKLY$5.99per weekfirst 3 days on the house

MONTHLY$14.99per monthfirst 7 days on the house

A card goes on file when you start the trial in the app. Cancel before your free days end and you pay nothing. Promo and referral codes apply at the plan step.

Fair questions.

Is this a meditation app?

No. There are no sessions and nothing to sit through. You open the hard thing and go. The layer works underneath while you work.

Is this a medical thing?

No. 10am is training, not treatment, and it makes no medical claims. It treats attention like a performance skill you build, not a condition you fix. And plainly: if focus struggles are seriously disrupting your life, a clinician beats an app.

Will I see it flickering?

For about a minute, faintly. Then it slips under your attention and you’re just working. Intensity is yours to set, down to imperceptible.

What about photosensitivity?

The layer uses gentle, low-contrast rhythms well clear of the harsh strobe range, and intensity is always under your control. If you’re photosensitive or flicker-sensitive, check with a clinician first.

Do I need headphones or a wearable?

No wearable, ever. 10am uses your screen and whatever audio you already work with. Music is optional. The layer carries its own quiet sound, and locks to yours the moment you press play.

What does it cost?

The download is free, and your first days are on the house — 3 on weekly ($5.99), 7 on monthly ($14.99), or 10 on yearly ($99.99). A card goes on file when you start your trial in the app; cancel before your free days end and you pay nothing. Yearly members can also pause up to 5 weeks a year.

Windows?

Yes — Windows 11. macOS came first and the newest features land there first, but both are fully local.

Made for your hardest hours.

Lives in your menu bar for when real work is on the line. Your best focused work block is the demo. Everything stays local. Our power users give their own tools local API or MCP access.

Download for macOS

Is this a meditation app?

不会。没有会议，也没有什么可以坐下来听的。 你打开坚硬的东西然后走。 当您工作时，该层在下面工作。

Is this a medical thing?

上午 10 点是训练，而不是治疗，并且没有任何医疗声明。 它将注意力视为您培养的表演技能，而不是您解决的条件。 简单地说：如果注意力不集中严重扰乱了你的生活，那么临床医生会击败应用程序。

Will I see it flickering?

大约一分钟，微弱地。 然后它就消失在你的注意力之下，你就只是在工作。 强度由您设定，小至难以察觉。

What about photosensitivity?

该图层使用温和、低对比度的节奏，远离刺耳的频闪范围，并且强度始终在您的控制之下。 如果您对光敏感或对闪烁敏感，请先咨询临床医生。

Do I need headphones or a wearable?

从来没有可穿戴设备。 10am 使用您的屏幕和您已经使用的任何音频。 音乐是可选的。 该图层带有自己的安静声音，并在您按下播放键时锁定您的声音。

What does it cost?

下载免费，您的第一天可以使用——每周 3 天（5.99 美元）、每月 7 天（14.99 美元）或每年 10 天（99.99 美元）。 当您在应用程序中开始试用时，一张卡就会被存档；在免费日结束前取消，您无需支付任何费用。 年度会员每年还可以暂停最多 5 周。

Windows?
